summary: A Depth 20 subscribe: the web adapter refuses it (Paytm streams five levels only); the desktop acknowledges depth 20 and streams the five-level FULL book.

notes: The web answers this subscribe with an error entry, "Invalid depth level 20. Paytm supports only 5 levels", and status partial (paytm_adapter.py:388-391, websocket_proxy/server.py:1318-1328); the reply is pinned here as the desktop sends it today.

deviations.reason: The web refuses a Depth subscribe at any depth but 5 ("Invalid depth level 20. Paytm supports only 5 levels", paytm_adapter.py:388-391), so it streams nothing; the desktop acknowledges depth 20 and streams five levels. A desktop acknowledgement gap: feed::dialect's DepthAck::Echo for Paytm needs a refusal for depths it does not serve (a shared file: BKD-06, for lanes wire/life).
